sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Shaftsbury, official results of the March 3, 2026 town meeting ballot (429 ballots cast; attested by Town Clerk Marlene Hall, March 4, 2026), published on the town website shaftsburyvt.gov: Thomas J. Dailey was elected Moderator with 362 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Shaftsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS - ELECTED' table (terms with expiry years): Marlene Hall holds the clerk's term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Marlene Hall as Shaftsbury's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Shaftsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS - ELECTED' table (terms with expiry years): Melanie Dexter holds the treasurer's term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Melanie Dexter as Shaftsbury's Town Treasurer

Town of Shaftsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS - ELECTED' table (terms with expiry years): Zoe Contros Kearl (Chair, term to 2028), Naomi Miller (Vice Chair, to 2027), Michael Cichanowski (to 2027), and Marlene Hall and Eamon Mulligan held or won the remaining seats

Town of Shaftsbury, official results of the March 3, 2026 town meeting ballot (429 ballots cast; attested by Town Clerk Marlene Hall, March 4, 2026), published on the town website shaftsburyvt.gov: Marlene Hall was elected to a two-year selectboard term (359 votes) and Eamon Mulligan to a three-year term (333 votes)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated
Town of Shaftsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS - ELECTED' table (terms with expiry years): Michael Caslin holds an auditor term to 2028; the third auditor seat is printed 'Vacant'

Town of Shaftsbury, official results of the March 3, 2026 town meeting ballot (429 ballots cast; attested by Town Clerk Marlene Hall, March 4, 2026), published on the town website shaftsburyvt.gov: Lisa Lent was re-elected auditor with 356 votes

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the certified listing names twelve winners for Shaftsbury's twelve justice of the peace seats. The 2025 annual report's Board of Civil Authority table swaps in Dave Mance and Katie Seaton for the listing's Nancy Burns and Carol Korman; on an equal-count name swap the certified listing governs, and Mance and Seaton are held as stragglers (flagged on issue #163)
